note: Ships in the GitHub clone. Full company software/algorithm face. No local algo-hub, no *_HOME, no circuit body, no twin_id, no LAN IP. Remote QAGENT_ALGO_HUB_URL or staff QAGENT_ALGO_HUB_HOME may overlay this file.

assets.title: QAOA MaxCut
assets.summary: QAOA modeling, circuit, evaluate, optimize. Typical problem MaxCut.
choose_when: Combinatorial optimization / MaxCut
do_not_choose_when: Electronic-structure ground state

assets.title: QRC MNIST
assets.summary: PCA → kicked Ising reservoir → linear readout. Demo task is MNIST.
choose_when: Classification / reservoir computing demo
do_not_choose_when: Chemistry energy evaluation

assets.title: First-order Trotter
assets.summary: Trotter circuit builder used by VQE/QAOA payloads. Not a standalone problem solver.
choose_when: Need a Trotter circuit from a VQE-style Hamiltonian payload
do_not_choose_when: User asked to solve a chemistry or MaxCut problem

assets.title: UQC HEA-VQE
assets.summary: Ion-trap VQE from a Pauli Hamiltonian JSON. No molecule/SCF stage.
choose_when: Input is already a SparsePauliOp / Pauli list
Want ion-trap HEA without chemistry
do_not_choose_when: Input is a molecule (use org.chem.vqe)

assets.title: ADAPT-VQE
assets.summary: Fermionic-pool ADAPT-VQE with commutator-gradient selection (quantum.algorithm=adapt).
choose_when: Need adaptive ansatz growth from a fermionic operator pool
do_not_choose_when: Want a fixed-depth HEA/UCC loop (use org.chem.vqe)
Want qubit-excitation IQEB (use org.chem.iqeb)

assets.title: DMET embedding
assets.summary: PySCF density-feedback DMET / projection workflows. Host algorithm stays VQE unless overridden.
choose_when: Molecule is too large for a single active space
User asks for DMET / fragment embedding

assets.title: QSE sidecar
assets.summary: Quantum Subspace Expansion sidecar. Not a standalone quantum.algorithm.
choose_when: Need QSE subspace expansion after a ground-state VQE
do_not_choose_when: User asked for VQD deflation or SCEOM

assets.title: SCEOM sidecar
assets.summary: Nested-commutator SCEOM sidecar on a VQE reference. Not a standalone quantum.algorithm.
choose_when: Need SCEOM excited states after VQE

assets.title: VQD sidecar
assets.summary: Deflation VQD after a variational ground-state run. Not a standalone quantum.algorithm.
choose_when: Need a few low-lying excited states after VQE
do_not_choose_when: User asked specifically for QSE or SCEOM

assets.title: GQE family
assets.summary: Generative Quantum Eigensolver and A1–A8 variants. Select a variant; default is gqe.
choose_when: Research generative / policy-based eigensolver
do_not_choose_when: Need a production ground-state energy (use org.chem.vqe)

assets.title: IQEB-VQE
assets.summary: Outer Pauli-selection loop with inner VQE (quantum.algorithm=iqeb).
choose_when: Need IQEB qubit-excitation pool and outer rounds
do_not_choose_when: Fermionic ADAPT is requested (use org.chem.adapt)

assets.title: QPE family
assets.summary: Kitaev / deterministic / information-theory QPE on the active-space Hamiltonian.
choose_when: User asks for quantum phase estimation rather than VQE
do_not_choose_when: Ordinary variational ground state is enough

assets.title: SA-VQE
assets.summary: Minimal state-averaged VQE with overlap penalty (quantum.algorithm=sa_vqe).
choose_when: Need several states in one variational loop
do_not_choose_when: Only the ground state is required (use org.chem.vqe)
Prefer a post-VQE sidecar (use org.chem.excited.*)

assets.title: SQD / QSCI family
assets.summary: Computational-basis sampling then classical subspace diagonalization (CBS / QSCI / SQD / SKQD).
choose_when: Sample configurations and classically diagonalize a subspace
do_not_choose_when: Need a standard variational VQE loop

assets.title: TETRIS-ADAPT-VQE
assets.summary: ADAPT-VQE with tetris-style parallel operator selection (quantum.algorithm=tetris_adapt).
choose_when: Need ADAPT with tetris-style / hardware-aware operator packing
do_not_choose_when: Standard fermionic ADAPT is enough (use org.chem.adapt)

assets.title: Q-chem VQE
assets.summary: Standard HEA/UCC VQE inside qchem-stack. Use when the input is a molecule, not a raw Pauli Hamiltonian.
choose_when: Problem has a molecule / basis / active space
Need chemistry pipeline, repro export, or MD/ML bridge
do_not_choose_when: Already have a SparsePauliOp and only need ion-trap VQE (use org.algo.vqe.hea)

assets.title: H2 ion-trap compiler
assets.summary: QASM to ion-trap controller schedule. Hardware topologies AGAGA/AAGAA/H1/H1_long.
choose_when: Have a circuit/QASM and need a hardware schedule
do_not_choose_when: Have a molecule and need an energy (use org.chem.*)

assets.title: uqcdemo
assets.summary: Jupyter demo for connecting to UQC cloud, compiling to rx/ry/rzz, submitting OpenQASM3. Not a solver.
do_not_choose_when: Agent needs to run a production algorithm

assets.title: iontrap_noise
assets.summary: Noise injection on Aer statevector for QCCD ion-trap circuits (RX/RZZ).

assets.title: qiskit-uqc-sim
assets.summary: Qiskit Provider/Backend for UnitQC ion-trap simulation (UQCBackend, noise, optimizer plugins).
choose_when: Need local ion-trap-like Qiskit backend
do_not_choose_when: Need a chemistry algorithm (use org.chem.* instead)

assets.title: UQC cloud backend
assets.summary: Single logical cloud runtime. Reached via uqc-client, qchem-stack-uqc plugin, or uqcdemo. Do not treat those as three machines.
choose_when: Submit static rx/ry/rzz circuits to company hardware
do_not_choose_when: Dynamic circuits or mid-circuit measurement

assets.title: qchem-stack
assets.summary: Chemistry → pre-quantum → quantum algorithms → protocols → jobs → repro → MD/ML. Primary config-driven surface for chemistry. Not a selectable solver; pick org.chem.* instead.

assets.title: uqc_algorithm
assets.summary: Ion-trap algorithm library with VQE, QAOA, QRC, Trotter and UQC primitives. JSON-task oriented, no chemistry pipeline. Not a selectable solver; pick org.algo.* instead.

assets.title: QCCD_workflow
assets.summary: Bundles H2 compiler + Aer/iontrap_noise + QV/GHZ/RCS benchmarks and Slurm HPC scripts.
